notes.title: Version 1.02d
notes.content: Added a small cross-promo reward related to my new game participating in Stem Next Fest.

notes.title: Version 1.02 - Pearls are now not reset on restart
notes.content:
[b][h3]Version 1.02[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pearls and pearl power are now not reset on restarts.
[*] Contract of the Drowners now increases the power of sea pearls (previously, this contract allowed you to not reset pearls).
[*] Added another special one-time reward when searching the junkyard.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.content:
[i]The game has been released![/i]

[b]Release! In general, the core of the game was ready quite a long time ago, but the planned faction of robots, as well as 'hanging' bugs prevented the release from early access. But now the game is finally out :)[/b]

This update itself is not too big. The thing is that you want to come out of the early access with the most stable version, so the number of changes in it is minimal.

[h3]Changelist:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes: corrected some grammatical and stylistic errors.
[*] Added free starter pack (junkyard).
[*] Holding shift now also affects the battery button on the energy screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.70 - More bugfixes
notes.content:
[u][b]Version 0.70[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rune prism bug that caused the prism to have no effect on crystal #2.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the warlock contract to not always give 1500 dark mana after restart.
[*] Fixed '0' in pearl names.
[*] Reset gears now remove gears from the robots faction.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver. 0.68 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
[u][b]Version 0.68 - Bugfixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the game save to be written to the clipboard by itself.
[*] Fixed a bug causing energy not being restored offline if the first crystal is not activated.
[*] The robot faction book is placed in a more appropriate place.
[/list]

notes.title: Robot Faction | Rusty World (final world)
notes.content:
Game updated!

[h3]Added robot faction[/h3]
In order to open the robot faction, you need to visit the rusty world. Robots create a resource "Power boost", which, in turn, increases the efficiency of crystals. Robots are not reset on normal restarts (but are reset when traveling through worlds).

[h3]Added Rusty World[/h3]
The Rusty World -- the final world in the game. It unlocks the robot faction, and, in a sense, its completion could be considered as the game finale. The robot faction, however, will also be unlocked to all other worlds after that.

notes.title: Version 0.61 - Undead world, new mushrooms
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
[b]Version 0.61[/b]

[h3]Changelist:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Warlocks] Added new contract that increases the maximum level of the base contracts (A, B, C, D, E, F).
[*] [Undead] Added new contract that allows you to get the essense.
[*] New world added: Undead world
[*] New mushrooms added (to get them you have to visit the undead world)
[*] the 'Rumors' spell now slightly reduces the difficulty of the world (in the first world this extra effect does not work)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.60 - secondary contracts for undea, dead man's piggy bank, sleep mode
notes.content:
Version 0.60b
It's not a huge update, but I hope it allows me to slowly get back to work. 

[h3]List of changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Undead] Added secondary contracts and the regular contract that opens them.
[*] [Undead] Added a dead man's piggy bank, a analogue of the infernal piggy bank, which allows you to get more prestige of the undead when you restart.
[*] Added setting: additional offline recalculation. It will help to recalculate offline if computer goes to sleep mode. And maybe fix other problems with energy regeneration. This setting will be ON by default.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.59 - Oyster of the Deep
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
[h2]Version 0.59[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added new mechanics: Deep Oyster and Power of Pearls. Now you can buy deep oysters for raw mana (like buying fire spheres for gems).

It took a long time to develop this mechanic, because raw mana existed for a long time without an additional bonus, so the new mechanics had to be built into the game very carefully.

[*] Added a new contract for drowners.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.58 - Unit descriptions, bugfixes
notes.content:
Version 0.58

[h3]Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Golden Gates: The difficulty of the world now has no effect on souls from the Break The Bond spell.
[*] Added remaining description texts for units.
[*] Fixed a bug when buying a contract after revisiting the world.
[*] The Сontract B of the Warlocks does not negate the free d'Esperance in the water (and later) worlds.
[*] Partially solved the problem with expanding the game window in the new world (or during the plague).
[*] And a few more bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.57 - Golden Gates and New Worlds
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
[h2]Version 0.57[/h2]

Added tab: [b]Golden Gates[/b].
You need 1000 gold or more to open this tab.

Through the golden gate you can enter other worlds. Entering a new world gives certain bonuses, which are kept between worlds. The new worlds have a higher difficulty (it depends on the type of world).In fact, the golden gate is the second level of restart in the game. Now 2 worlds have been added: the water world and the fire world.

[h3]In addition:[/h3][list]
[*] Extra Options: Added option to disable special screen effects (plague, worlds)
[*] Arena: fixed water ring, fixed formula description
[/list]

notes.title: Versions 0.55 and 0.56
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.56[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bugfixes
[*] Arena Mode. Added a new hero: the Warlock. When reborn, this hero boosts money received from monsters (this is a permanent bonus for all heroes).
[/list]
The option to increase gold will be needed for the new Golden Gate mechanics, which is currently in development. It is planned that the Golden Gates will be the second level of prestige in the game.


[h3]Version 0.55[/h3]
[list]
[*] Arena graphics have been partially updated.
[*] A new tab has been added to the settings menu ("Save problems"). If you have ever had problems saving the game or losing progress, pay attention to this tab. If everything is okay, you can ignore this tab.
[*] Fixed a bug with the same name of mushrooms.
[*] Fixed the ring of greed bug and a few other minor bugs for the arena.
[*] Bugfix: time spell to grow a bone mushroom did not use energy.
[/list]

notes.title: Versions 0.54
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.54[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base effect of fire spheres, fire skulls, bottles of tears and dark amulets increased: +50% -> +100% to productivity.
[*] Units no longer need to have an upgrade to get spheres, skulls, bottles and amulets.
[*] Contracts related to spheres, skulls, bottles and amulets gained +1 max level.
[*] Added LOCAL backups.
[*] [Demons] Infernal piggy bank has been redesigned.
[*] [Demons] Added contract: Auto-Buy. With it, the CEO will be able to create units without your involvement.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.53 - Runes (new mechanics), buy button settings
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
Version 0.53


[list]
[*] Added additional settings for Buy Max button. (Max, 10%, Next) 'Next' duplicates the behavior of the control button. These settings will be available from the beginning of the game.
[*] [Demons] A new sub-tab, RUNES, has been added. It will be opened by collecting 35 hell ashes.
[*] [Demons] Changed Contract: Hiring Practices -> Permanent Runes.
[/list]

notes.title: Versions 0.52 and 0.52b
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.52[/h3]
[list]
[*] [i][Challenges][/i] Added a warning about resetting the game to the challenges description.
[*] [i][Challenges][/i] Hell ashes is no longer required for starting the challenge.
[*] [i][Exchange][/i] The 'max' option has been added to the resource exchange menu buttons.
[*] [i][Demons][/i] Added a contract that allows to increase the maximum number of units in the list of units for all factions.
[*] [i][Undead][Drowners][Warlocks][/i] Added new portraits and unit names.
[*] Fixed a bug with the chest gears not working (happened if you take the spell 'key from the chest').
[*] Quickfix (ver. 0.25b): fixed bug when resetting gears, fixed ash and powder exchange.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.50 - Arena (work in progress), Warlocks automation, bugfixes
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
Version 0.50

[list]
[*] Added a minigame: Arena. The arena is still in development, as it turned out to be larger than I expected. Currently there will be one hero and 23 items available, later new items and a new hero will be added.
[*] [Warlocks] Added 3 new contracts.
[*] [Warlocks] Fixed a bug when opening contracts.
[*] [Grimoire] Added Spell: Summon a Hero (Class: Demon)
[*] Fixed bug with inability to load 'Load: Tokens' from cloud backup.
[/list]

notes.title: Versions 0.49 and 0.49b
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.49[/h3][list]
[*] Added a new spell: Break the bond. With this spell, you no longer need raw mana to create blackseekers, but souls are required instead.
[*] Added a new spell: Ouroboros. With this spell the number of units is not reset on restart (but it has a cooldown).
[*] Added a contract for warlocks, allowing you to automate their upgrades.
[*] Added a warlocks contract allowing you to set the Time Control and Key to the Chest spells as global spells (this will not interfere with the global spell from the first page).
[*] Added a new grimoire page that announces the ARENA mode. The arena mode itself is currently in development.
[/list]

[h3]Version 0.49b[/h3][list]
[*] Added two new warlocks contracts.
[*] Added a new settings section (extra settings). There you can set the time between autosaves.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.48c - Small update (control, shift, drowners automation)
notes.content:
Version 0.48c. Small udpate.

[list]
[*] Added settings that allow you to use the right mouse button as shift+left mouse, and the middle button as control+click.
[*] Auto-recycle settings are now kept on restart. Also, a setting has been added that allows reverting to the previous variant.
[*] Added a setting that allows hiding the effect of the waste (popup text).
[*] Added two new drowners contracts. One of them allows you to automate upgrades of drowners.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.48 - Secondary Contracts for Demons, Infernal Piggy Bank
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
Version 0.48

[list]
[*] Added infernal piggy bank, which allows you to automatically get hell ashes. In addition, the piggy bank works offline.
[*] Added secondary demon contracts. Secondary contracts have no maximum level limit and their cost does not increase with level.
[*] Added 2 demon contracts that open the previously written.
[*] Added 3 secondary contracts.
[*] Fixed several errors in the text and a bug with button appearing.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.47g - Small update (gear reset improved)
notes.content:
Version 0.47g. Small udpate.

Gears reset has been reworked. A separate window now opens where you can choose to reset both unit gears and boiler/obelisk/chest gears. Periodically, you will be able to get free charges for resetting. The mechanics of the junkyard search are used for this.

There is 1 free charge at the start. If you have previously purchased gear resets, they will be converted to additional free resets.

notes.title: Version 0.47 - Altars/rotten dolls Automation, New Boiler, The Countdown
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
Version 0.47

[h3]Undead[/h3][list]
[*] Added lich hall, allowing you to automate the creation of rotten dolls and soul altars. In addition, the lich collects essence, which is needed for some mushrooms.
[*] Added two new contracts.
[/list]

[h3]Demons[/h3][list]
[*] Added boiler C. When you restart the game through this boiler, you will get the waste from boiler A and perstige from boiler B.
[*] Added "The Countdown", which allows you to use boilers [b]without restarting the game[/b] (after a certain amount of time).
[*] Added 2 contracts, basically to unlock the features above.
[/list]

[h3]Mushroom Farm[/h3][list]
[*] Added bone mushroom, giving +100 bone flour.
[*] Added ruby mushroom, which allows you to reset the cost of gems recycling.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the display of the number of dark amulets.
[*] Fixed bug with possible loss of prestige if the game is closed too quickly after restart.
[*] Fixed (hopefully) a known bug with the occasionally non-functioning Create [Max] button.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.46 - Warlocks restart, Global spells, Gift from the chest
notes.content:
The game has been updated!
Version 0.46

[h3]Warlocks[/h3][list]
[*] Added RESTART for warlocks.
[*] Six basic contracts have been added.
[/list]

[h3]Drowners[/h3][list]
[*] Added a gift from the chest. Gift can be received after restart of drowners, if you have a certain contract. Then you can give the gift to Lilith (only to her at the moment) and get a bonus.
[*] New contracts have been added.
[*] You can now insert gears into the drowners chest (with a certain contract).
[/list]

[h3]Grimoire[/h3][list]
[*] Added four new spells.
[*] Added global spell mechanics. Global spell always works and does not take a slot in the grimoire. To create a global spell you need to make a restart of warlocks.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed problem with hourly backup not working.
[*] Rotten mushrooms were given after any restart, but should have been given only when using the obelisk.
[*] It was possible to buy unavailable artifact (tokens will be returned).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.45
notes.content:
Game updated!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Undead] Added contract to increase dark mana from mushrooms and from the contract J.
[*] [Undead] Added a contract that enhances getting waste from mushrooms and gives a way to get additional waste when using the obelisk.
[*] [Warlocks] New portraits added.
[*] Added artifacts (junkyard tab) as an additional alternative to gears. Nine artifacts have been added so far.
[*] Fixed a bug with the timer when exiting the challenge.
[*] A cloud backup system has been added. It can be found in the settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.44
notes.content:
Game updated!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Demons] Added a contract that opens the CEO Cabinet. There you can set up auto-buy and auto-distribute for fire spheres and skulls.
[*] [Demons] Added a contract that allows you to expand the list of demons. (Relevant if you reach the last demon on the list.)
[*] [Demons] Added contract that increases max level of J, K, L, M contracts.
[*] [Demons] Added a contract that enhances the contract H.
[*] [Demons] New portraits added.
[*] [Grimoire] The Red Rose spell can be upgraded. Specifically, this spell will allow you to gain +1 hell ashes when recycling. (This requires high levels of contract K.)
[*] Fixed a bug with the display of the final multiplier of warlocks (the bug affected only the description when hovering over the portrait).
[*] Quickfix: Red Rose spell.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.43
notes.content:
Game updated!

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Warlocks can now create bottles of mermaid tears and dark amulets.
[*] Added bottle of mermaid's tears: +50% to drowner productivity.
[*] Added dark amulet: +50% to warlock productivity.
[*] Added a setting that allows you to hide contracts with a max level.
[*] Added a setting that allows you to hide contracts if there is not enough prestige to get them.
[*] Added the feature that allows you to return gears given out to units.
[*] Added a setting: to give a gear to a unit, you must click on the button while holding down control key. This setting is useful if you're worried about accidentally wasting a gear.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.42c - contract to limit the number of units you buy by holding Control
notes.content:
Version 0.42c - small update

[list]
[*] It is now possible to limit the number of units you buy by holding Control. However, in order to do this you will need to take a special demon contract (50 prestige).
[*] Advanced options for navigation arrows have appeared in the settings. Now you can use these arrows to quickly move through the list of units (right click).
[*] Fixed an error in displaying the formula for dark mana from the Obelisk.
[/list]

notes.title: Game updated: version 0.42
notes.content:
Version 0.42

[h3]Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Demons] Contract C has been changed. Now it gives +60 energy, but only for the first 10 recyclings of gems (20, 30... depends on the level of the contract).
[*] [Demons] Contract K: Added the third level of the contract (auto upgrades 25 times per second).
[*] [Undead] Two new contracts have been added.
[*] [Drowners] New contract added.
[*] [Drowners] Contract B now gives +100 dark mana, but only for the first 10 recyclings of raw mana (20, 30... depends on the level of the contract).
[*] Shift-click now works when exchanging ashes and flour.
[*] I think buying tokens shouldn't be laggy now (sometimes too many tokens were given).
[*] A soft restart button has been added to the menu (just in case).
[*] Fixed a bug in displaying the effect of the magic powder.
[*] "Animal Instincts" spell has been made more powerful. (But it can be changed later, when I finish the second page completely.)
[/list]

notes.title: Game updated: version 0.41
notes.content:
Version 0.41

[h3]Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Grimoire: added transition to the second page.
[*] Grimoire: added 4 new spells.
[*] Added special options when restarting.
[*] Settings: you can set the unit's cost in souls to be shown in the selected notation.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick update: 3 contracts (and restart) for the drowners
notes.content:
Version 0.40d

Added restart for drowners.

At the moment, the drowners only have 3 basic contracts, but I decided that it would be better to publish the update with these three contracts right now.

notes.title: Game updated: version 0.40
notes.content:
Game updated! 
(version 0.40)

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added mushroom farm (undead faction). Overall, the farm is still in development, and only one mushroom works.
[*] Mushroom Farm: added dark mushroom (+150 dark mana or +1500 waste).
[*] Added names to warlocks.
[*] Changed cost formulas for warlock faction units. Now they don't need souls, but they need raw mana.
[*] Added information about getting the option to press the buttons 25 times/second to the recycling screen.
[/list]

[i]The next update will be devoted primarily to the restart/prestige of the drowners.[/i]

notes.title: Game updated: version 0.39
notes.content:
Game updated! 
(version 0.39)

[list]
[*] Added a notice with information about game updates.
[*] Added a "Log" button to the settings menu for viewing the history of changes.
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[*] Two special packs were added to the token store.
